title: Refund Recovery Tracker
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=firefly:txn
| where amount>0 AND match(description,"(?i)refund|reversal|chargeback")
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount) as recovered by merchant _time
| sort - recovered
description: Adds up refunds, reversals, and recovered charges so you can quantify how much money you successfully clawed back each month.
value: Recoveries are easy to mentally net out and forget; tracking them separately rewards the administrative effort of fixing billing mistakes.
implementation: Export transaction descriptions into Splunk; review monthly refund totals and the merchants most associated with reversals.
visualization: Monthly chart of recovered dollars by merchant.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how much money you got back this month from refunds and reversed charges.
